$comment: The e2e page's consent scenarios; tc-string.ts encodes them into site/public/tcf.js, and the page picks one with ?consent=<name> (given by default). A scenario with a TC string gets vendor consent for every GVL ID the bundle's modules declare (prebid-modules.json, from prebid.js's metadata) plus extraVendors. See AGENTS.md.

given.description: GDPR applies; consent to everything the tests need

denied.description: GDPR applies; no purpose 1 consent, for vendors or the publisher

notApplicable.description: GDPR doesn't apply; no TC string
